mentions.name: kete
mentions.description: An open-source Rust orbital mechanics library for computing asteroid orbits and identifying known asteroids, part of the code behind the author's astrometry.space processing tools. Written while the author worked at Caltech, it is used on the SphereX, NEO Surveyor, and Roman telescopes to identify known asteroids.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Some of the code is public, the orbital mechanics code I wrote while I worked at Caltech. Which is being used on SphereX, NEO Surveyor, and the Roman telescopes to identify known asteroids.
https://github.com/dahlend/kete
